field_defect_repaired: A private witness/instrument mismatch and a material public-state mismatch shared one CORRECTION_DUE lane, causing internal witness-schema bookkeeping to be posted publicly to Square participants without Campfire Square context.
repair_summary: Split witness investigations from public correction obligations. Add a local-only, evidence-bound resolution action that re-reads direct/public-thread surfaces, compares immutable intended IDs and hashes, appends local evidence and disposition, and invokes no Square write route or quota.
unchanged_boundaries: No new Square write route or public action type; no credential, quota, standing-grant, high-reach-review, target, retry, update-authentication or deletion change. The resolver records fresh equality only and does not establish historical cause, instrument validity or semantic truth.
claim_ceiling: Working candidate only. Repository publication is not package authentication, installation, release, validation, authority, permission or clearance.
